nodes.label: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
nodes.author: Dingjie Song, Hanrong Zhang, Dawei Liu, Yixin Liu, Zongxia Li, Zhengqing Yuan, Siqi Zhang, Henry Peng Zou, Zhiling Yan, Yuxuan Zhang, Yanfang Ye, Philip S. Yu, Lichao Sun
nodes.rationale: Proposes a human-in-the-loop research orchestration system that wraps existing coding agents with persistent state objects and skill libraries to improve controllability and auditability of AI-assisted research workflows.

nodes.label: Vibe Research Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Defines a controllable, human-in-the-loop research orchestration mode where AI handles high-throughput execution (retrieval, coding, analysis) while humans govern direction, evaluation criteria, and final acceptance decisions.

nodes.label: Dr. Claw State Objects
nodes.rationale: Four persistent state objects (Task Graph, Artifact Store, Decision Log, Execution Trace) that convert interaction history into a reviewable process supporting iterative orchestration and auditability.

nodes.label: Skill Library
nodes.rationale: Reusable, stage-mapped skills (58 across five research stages, 171 in deployed catalogue) covering ideation, literature processing, experimentation, analysis, and writing, versioned and schema-checked before activation.

nodes.label: Orchestration Layer
nodes.rationale: Wraps existing command-line coding agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI) with task-graph-centric orchestration, chat-driven planner, and multi-executor coordination to enable controllable, auditable research workflows.

nodes.label: Dr. Claw Workflow Steps
nodes.rationale: Iterative workflow cycle: Plan → Execute → Verify → Write-back, with explicit human checkpoints supporting revise/retry/handoff recovery without losing process state.

nodes.label: Research Completeness Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Measures fraction of 21 research best-practice elements (code reproducibility, multiple models, cross-validation, calibration, ablation, statistical rigor, figures, writeup, limitations, subgroup analysis, citations) spontaneously included in outputs.

nodes.label: Dr. Claw Human Study
nodes.rationale: Retrospective three-condition study with seven AI PhD researchers comparing Dr. Claw against no-AI and general-purpose web/desktop AI assistants on completion time, output quality, tool-switching count, and experience.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Failure Recovery
nodes.rationale: Auditable, structured artifact trail maintained by orchestration layer enables in-place project recovery from induced failures while preserving all prior files and execution history.

nodes.label: Permission Management
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained tool/command policies distinguishing secure defaults from trusted extended settings, with actions allowed only if they belong to action set defined by current policy.

nodes.label: Dr. Claw Three-Layer Architecture
nodes.rationale: Interaction layer (unified workspace for chat, tasks, files), Orchestration layer (state and lifecycle management), and Execution layer (backend invocation and exception handling) enabling backend switching without changing workflow semantics.

nodes.label: Skill Manifest (SKILL.md)
nodes.rationale: Directory-based skill format with YAML frontmatter declaring name, description, version, license, allowed tools, and stage/domain tags; versioned and schema-checked before activation.

nodes.label: Stage-Skill Map
nodes.rationale: Resolves task's stage and type to set of suggested skills, attached to task node and injected into next-action prompt; supports keyword detection and manual invocation.

nodes.label: Five Research Stages
nodes.rationale: Survey, Ideation, Experiment, Publication, and Promotion stages organizing research workflow with stage-specific skills and task decomposition.

nodes.label: Five Core AI Research Operations
nodes.rationale: Literature review, idea generation, code implementation, results analysis, and drafting—the core operations that Dr. Claw orchestrates through AI execution with human oversight.

nodes.label: Research Hygiene Elements
nodes.rationale: Limitations section, subgroup analysis, and real related-work citations—research-hygiene components where Dr. Claw's skill library reliably adds value over bare agent (0.33→1.00, 0.33→1.00, 0.00→0.67 pooled pass rates).

nodes.label: Context-Switching Costs
nodes.rationale: HCI evidence shows collaboration cost dominated by verification and context maintenance; Dr. Claw reduces cross-tool orchestration costs through unified workspace and persistent state objects.

nodes.label: Research-Centric Artifact Management
nodes.rationale: Dr. Claw emphasizes sustained human takeover and artifact management across full ideation→experiment→publication arc, distinguishing it from end-to-end autonomous approaches.
